unmeasuredCoverage.quality: No per-query relevance judgments collected; known-item rank/relative R13 recall is a separate instrument.
unmeasuredCoverage.cost: Attempt costUsd is null; zero external API spend cannot substitute for measured execution cost.
unmeasuredCoverage.prospectiveBudgets: Retain original declarations; missing class-specific quality, cost and latency bounds require a new prospective declaration before treatment.
unmeasuredCoverage.productAdapters: R10 invokes Papercusp in-process runHybridSearch for work_item/session_turn only. Other inventoried Papercusp entrypoints and every Restart adapter are unmeasured by R10.
unmeasuredCoverage.freshness: Prior field policies remain prospective; R10 has no canonical field/value/source-revision/current-authority-epoch witness.
